rationale: Closed-loop AV failure probability under a probabilistic perception error model; average-case closed-loop analysis, not operational-profile testing or reliability (OPREL).
lifts=none: main modelling assumption is the per-benchmark specification/input set, explicitly stated for each instance; no evidence it matches deployment.
Codebook tier A requires a task of an autonomous vehicle; fuel-consumption estimation for a human-driven PHEV is not one.
Exchangeability for L_conc is stated; evidenced by held-out test coverage above 90% (Fig. 9) and synthetic-vs-real parameter comparison (Fig. 7).
Headline coverage-gap results use real-world recorded datasets (airfoil self-noise, PeMSD4/8, Seattle-loop, epidemic data), not a simulator.
Lyapunov function is quadratic (QC/sector SDP on NN controller), not neural; NN-control-system stability/ROA certificate fits CLR, not NCERT.
NN sector bounds are carried through the (data-represented) LTI plant model via Lyapunov SDP to closed-loop stability over the ROA.
